updateFieldValue.prodFlowType: =IF(orderPurchaseType == 'POR' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'POR', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'ACT' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'LINEA_NUEVA', IF( orderPurchaseType == 'ATT' && hasESIM == false , "KIT" , IF(orderProductType == 'Handset' && (orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' || (hasESIM == true && orderPurchaseType == 'ATT')), "TERM_LIBRE", IF(orderProductType == 'Tech' && (orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' || (hasESIM == true && orderPurchaseType == 'ATT')),"TEC",'')))))
updateFieldValue.quantity: =COUNTQUERY ("SELECT COUNT() FROM OrderItem WHERE OrderItem.Product2.Name = '{0}' AND OrderId = '{1}'" , productName, orderId)
updateFieldValue.salesProcess: =IF(orderPurchaseType == 'POR' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'POR', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'ACT' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'ACT', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' && orderProductType == 'Handset', 'NAP', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' && orderProductType == 'Tech', 'TEC', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'ATT', 'NAP', '')))))
updateFieldValue.salesType: =IF(orderPurchaseType == 'POR' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'POSTPAGO', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'ACT' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'POSTPAGO', IF((orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' || orderPurchaseType == 'ATT') && orderProductType == 'Handset', 'LIBRE', IF((orderPurchaseType == 'NAP' || orderPurchaseType == 'ATT') && orderProductType == 'Tech', 'LIBRE', IF(orderPurchaseType == 'ATT' && orderProductType == 'SIM Card', 'SIM', '')))))
